name: cable incline triceps extension
description: Overhead cable triceps extension from a low pulley with a straight bar. It isolates the triceps, especially the long head, through a deep stretch behind the head.
instructions: Set an incline bench with its top end in front of a low pulley with a straight bar.
Lie back on the bench and hold the bar overhand, arms extended up over your head.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten your arms to bring the bar back up.
Keep your elbows pointing up and close to your head.
